Process

From idea to live
in three steps

Lightweight, transparent, and built around shipping — not meetings.

01
STEP 01

Discover

A short call to understand the problem, the constraints, and what success looks like. You leave with a written scope and a fixed quote.

02
STEP 02

Build

I work in tight increments with regular updates. You see progress in a staging environment, not in long status reports.

03
STEP 03

Ship

Production deploy, documentation, and a handoff so your team can run with it. 30 days of post-launch support included.
